data.reason: Independent manual content review of this standalone artifact against every retained original requirement.
data.rationale: A real training-only imputer and NearestCentroid classifier learn means/classes/centroids. The lesson computes distance reasoning, exposes changed learned state and changed prediction after a training perturbation, and evaluates an untouched worked validation set. Its new independent problem changes feature count/names, ID naming, unknown/normal label codes and output format; students select and fit a defensible learned classifier, inspect its learned values, predict and explain accuracy. This is a bounded material-design judgment, not complete Antique, future-exam or measured learner success.
